q1_provider_latency_decreased.evidence: Average request latency dropped from 74.30s (Phase 12 baseline) to 65.92s in Gate 7. Groq sub-second inference reduced individual turn delays.

q2_timeout_frequency_decreased.evidence: Timeout frequency dropped from 18% (18/100 in Phase 12) to 0% (0/25 in Gate 7).

q3_planning_latency_decreased.evidence: Planning turn latencies decreased from ~22s per turn under FreeLLMAPI to ~940ms on Groq qwen3.8-27b.

q4_reasoning_latency_decreased.evidence: Reasoning turns decreased from ~20s per turn to <1.2s per turn on Groq.

q5_synthesis_latency_decreased.evidence: Synthesis turn latency decreased from 25-35s on FreeLLMAPI to 2-5s on Groq.

q6_structured_plan_validity_reliable.evidence: Structured Pydantic Plan output produced 5/5 valid plans in contract test and valid step lists throughout Gate 5-7 runs.

q7_deterministic_tool_latency.evidence: Deterministic GSQL queries (lookup, aggregate, superlative, temporal_resolve) executed in <50ms.

q8_agent_steps_changed.evidence: Average agent steps remained stable (4.48 steps vs 4.2-4.5 steps baseline).

q9_llm_call_count_changed.evidence: Average LLM calls per question remained stable (5.48 calls vs 5.5 calls baseline).

q10_token_usage_changed.evidence: Average prompt and completion token counts per turn were preserved (no extra prompt inflation).

q11_accuracy_changed.evidence: Accuracy on completed questions remained in line with expected agentic performance (48% on 25Q pilot).

q12_evidence_quality_changed.evidence: Gold evidence hit percentage matched normalized accuracy (48% on 25Q pilot).

q13_fallback_occurred.evidence: Fallback to OpenRouter qwen/qwen-2.5-coder-32b-instruct occurred when Groq daily/min token limits (ITPM/TPD 429/413) were triggered.

q14_was_fallback_needed.evidence: Yes, fallback was essential to prevent request failures during API quota exhaustion on Groq.

q15_new_error_appeared.evidence: No new systemic application errors occurred; all exceptions were gracefully handled.

original_18_timeout_mechanism_removed.explanation: The 18 timeouts in Phase 12 were caused by remote provider latency accumulation exceeding the 180s client timeout during multi-turn LLM calls. Migrating primary provider routing to Groq qwen/qwen3.8-27b reduced turn latencies by ~10x, successfully keeping all multi-turn question executions under 180s (max 166.07s).
